title: Jonathan Livingston Seagull
author: Richard Bach
summary: A seagull cares more about flying faster and better than about searching for food with the flock. His devotion to flight leads to exile, then to a higher kind of understanding that he shares with other gulls.
readIf: you want a brief, allegorical fable about following your passion and growing beyond the crowd.
skipIf: you find parable-style spirituality sentimental or overly simple.
